dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a pre-build product and feature review workflow focused on demand, distribution, pricing, retention, trust, and validation before coding.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some trigger examples such as asking whether to add a feature are broad enough to route ordinary product discussions into this skill, but the scope is disclosed and the skill explicitly excludes coding, architecture, security, and technical review tasks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is by cloning, registry install, or copying Markdown/YAML instruction files; no install script, executable payload, dependency package, or automatic command execution is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Normal use requires no shell, file writes, credentials, or network access. The optional Case Memory API is disclosed, consent-gated, limited to a minimal idea summary, and explicitly says not to send secrets or private data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts do not request persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, credential/session access, destructive actions, or broad local indexing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger examples are real and could cause misrouting, but they are aligned with the stated product/feature review purpose and are mitigated by explicit exclusions and a no-code hard gate; this is guidance-level rather than a Review-bucket concern.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is clean, with no malicious or suspicious detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
[staticScan] expected: Static/component scans show Markdown/YAML files only, no executable scripts, no dependencies, and no suspicious patterns, matching the skill's text-only design.
llm.guidance: Install this when you want an agent to challenge a product or feature idea before building. Invoke it explicitly for product-risk review, not for code review, security review, or architecture decisions. If you approve the optional Case Memory lookup, share only a short non-confidential idea summary and do not send secrets, customer names, private financials, credentials, or unreleased details.
llm.summary: This is a text-only product-risk review skill with disclosed, optional case lookup and no executable payload.
